description: Defines a Flutter widget 'NewsListItem' for displaying news articles with image, title, and timestamp; includes internal classes and methods for rendering and formatting.

classes.name: NewsListItem
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a news article with image, title, and timestamp, and handles tap interactions.

classes.name: _ArticleImage
classes.description: A widget that displays an article image or a placeholder/error icon if image URL is invalid or loading fails.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the news list item, including image, title, and timestamp.

methods.name: _formatTime
methods.description: Formats the article's timestamp into either absolute date or relative hours ago.
